claims.text: The trace produced by the driver's own device places him inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius for one continuous qualifying run of 255 seconds, from 23:42:21 to 23:46:36, against an AIRPORT minimum dwell of 480 seconds. That is 225 seconds short. Under POL-NS-01(c) the dwell condition fails, and under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. I disclose that this artifact is impaired: EV-GPS-00210 carries weight 0.25 and the issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD. The shortfall I rely on is the trace's own qualifying run on the trace's own device stamps - the reading that requires no correction in the driver's favour.

The trip record's own figure defeats the charge without any help from the trace. EV-TRIP-00210 records wait_time_min of 6.9 minutes - 414 seconds from its arrived marker at 23:42:10 to the 23:49:05 cancellation - which is short of the 480 second (8 minute) AIRPORT minimum, and which directly contradicts the driver's statement that he was at Door 6 'for more than eight minutes'. I disclose that this artifact is impaired: weight 0.4, issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, its arrived_at and implied dwell being irreconcilable with EV-GPS-00210. Even on the record's own, most generous figure, POL-NS-01(c) fails and POL-NS-06 requires a full refund.

The admissibility note on the trace itself records that, read at face value, the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 23:42:21 and the dwell is 404 seconds - still 76 seconds short of the 480 second AIRPORT minimum. That is the most driver-favourable reading of the trace available without correcting its device clock, and it fails POL-NS-01(c) and produces a full refund under POL-NS-06 on its own. I disclose the impairment of EV-GPS-00210: weight 0.25, issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD.

POL-NS-01(b) requires the trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the arrived event, and POL-NS-02 fixes that test at three consecutive fixes within 150 m of the pin. The arrived event is 23:42:10; the trace's first qualifying in-radius fix is 23:42:21, and its 186 second gap from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 covers the arrival moment entirely, so no fix of any kind corroborates the marker. The waiting clock must therefore run from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and on that recomputed basis the dwell is below the AIRPORT minimum. Whether the outcome is reached through POL-NS-05(i) (corrected dwell under the minimum: full refund, no compensation payable) or through POL-NS-06 (effective in-geofence dwell under the minimum: full refund), the fee falls. I disclose the impairment of EV-GPS-00210 at weight 0.25 (CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD) and of EV-TRIP-00210 at weight 0.4 (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT).

No traffic advisory covers the Changi T1 arrival kerb in this window: EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING, has no payload and carries weight 0.0. Under POL-NS-06(i) a MISSING advisory makes the accumulation limb unavailable, so separate in-geofence intervals cannot be summed - which matches a computed accumulated dwell of 0.0 seconds and run_count of 0, and leaves the single 255 second qualifying run as the whole of the driver's in-geofence presence. The driver cannot extend that run by reaching for an advisory that does not exist, and asserting a case against a MISSING artifact is a POL-NS-09 matter rather than an exoneration.

derived.rider_presence.available is false and rider_fix_count is 0: the trace carries no rider track at all, so POL-NS-04(c) - whether the rider's device sat within the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes - cannot be run. POL-NS-04(c) directs that limb (c) is in that situation UNDECIDABLE and neutral, neither satisfied nor failed, and POL-NS-08(b) treats the omission as a trace defect. Nothing may be inferred against the rider from a track that does not exist; his account that he was standing at Door 6 is simply uncontradicted on his side of the record, and the dispute must be decided on the driver's dwell, where the charge already fails. I disclose the impairment of EV-GPS-00210 at weight 0.25, including the PARTIAL_RECORD issue.

EV-CHAT-00210 is truncated: its own msg_id sequence numbering, and trip_record.chat_message_count of 4 against a message_count of 2, show that MSG-00210-002 and MSG-00210-003 - sent somewhere in the 23:42 to 23:49 window - are absent from the export. That is the POL-NS-08(c) chat defect, and the artifact carries weight 0.6 with issue code TRUNCATED_LOG. The gap falls exactly where a rider locating message and any driver reply would sit, so the driver cannot use the export to prove that the rider failed to coordinate under POL-NS-04(a); on the surviving record the driver posted no reply and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. Either way POL-NS-04 is not made out on what survives, and the case reverts to POL-NS-01, where the dwell fails.

If the judge concludes that arrival and dwell can only be carried by EV-GPS-00210, then POL-NS-08 governs on its own terms: 228 seconds of device-clock skew against the 90 second limb in POL-NS-08(a), and a 186 second gap inside the waiting window, 9 fixes across a 915 second active window, and no rider track under POL-NS-08(b). The ruling may then not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(e). POL-GEN-02(2) independently caps confidence at the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact - 0.25 for the trace, 0.40 at best for the trip record - far below the 0.70 platform floor, so POL-NS-09(a) is engaged as well. On that route the $6 is held rather than collected and the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved.

EV-FARE-00210 shows payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and total_charged 6.00, so the charge is live and nothing has been returned to the rider. POL-GEN-03 makes NO_ACTION party-relative: on this rider-filed dispute it would leave that $6 exactly where it is, which is the one outcome the evidence does not support. The rider asks for FULL_REFUND on the POL-NS-06 shortfall, and in the alternative ESCALATE under POL-NS-09, which holds the disputed fee rather than collecting it - either way the rider is left not carrying the disputed charge.

claims.text: The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 23:42:10 and records the trip terminated by the driver at 23:49:05 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which satisfies POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d). The artifact is impaired (weight 0.4; issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT) and I disclose that, but the existence of the two terminal events is not contradicted by any other artifact in the bundle, and nothing in the record shows a boarding event.

The POL-NS-02 proximity test for the pickup point is met on the driver's own device trace: the derived arrival block reports 5 qualifying in-radius fixes and a driver track whose minimum distance from the pin is 96.0 m, inside the 150 m arrival radius fixed for the AIRPORT zone class. The artifact is impaired and I disclose it: weight 0.25, issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

The only measurement of in-geofence dwell in this bundle is the derived longest_qualifying_run: 255.0 s, running from 23:42:21 to 23:46:36. That run ends at the trace's own last fix, 149 s before the driver cancelled at 23:49:05, so the run is truncated by the log rather than terminated by the driver leaving. A trace impaired under POL-NS-08(b) by a 186 s sampling gap sitting exactly across geofence entry, and by coverage of only 22.8%, cannot affirmatively show that the hold fell short of the 480 s AIRPORT minimum, and under POL-NS-08 an artifact this broken cannot alone support a shortfall finding against the driver.

The rider's account that she stood at Door 6 throughout is uncorroborated and cannot exonerate her under POL-NS-04. That clause requires all three limbs, and limb (c) asks where the rider's device was; the trace carries no rider track at all (rider_fix_count 0, rider_qualifying_fix_count 0), so limb (c) is undecidable and neutral, and POL-NS-04 does not apply. No inference of rider presence may be drawn from an absent rider track.

POL-NS-04 limb (a) fails independently. It requires a locating or coordinating rider message sent during the waiting window, and the only surviving rider message is MSG-00210-004 sent at 23:49:40, 35 seconds after the driver terminated the trip at 23:49:05. The chat export is impaired (weight 0.6; issue TRUNCATED_LOG) with messages 002 and 003 missing, so the export cannot show any coordinating message sent while the driver waited, and the rider's non-response is as consistent with her absence as with any fault of the driver's.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged and cannot be used to declare the arrival marker false. It bites only where the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or above at the arrived timestamp of 23:42:10; the trace's longest gap runs from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 and swallows that exact moment, so the trace says nothing at all about the driver's position or motion at the arrival marker. Absent a qualifying fix showing motion or distance, neither POL-NS-05(i) nor POL-NS-05(ii) is triggered.

POL-NS-03 — the wrong-entrance route to a full refund — is not engaged. That clause applies only where the driver held position outside the arrival radius; here the qualifying fixes place the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius, so the driver did reach the pickup point and the mislocation theory is closed. In any event venue_id is null on both the pickup pin and the trace, so no venue-based relocation argument is available to either side and the distance test governs alone.

There is no traffic advisory for the Changi T1 arrival kerb in this window: EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and has no payload, and its absence is itself citable. POL-NS-06(i) requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed, so the accumulation route is unavailable and the derived accumulated_dwell stands at 0.0 s with the limb marked unavailable. Nothing here permits the rider to build a dwell out of disconnected fragments.

The $6.00 cancellation fee is correctly itemised, so the fare-defect limb of POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. The AIRPORT zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00; the resolution rule takes the GREATER, which is SGD 6.00, and the fare_breakdown cancellation_fee line is exactly SGD 6.00. There is accordingly no fare irregularity on which the rider can attack the charge.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and no abuse escalation is available against the driver. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the 4 the clause requires, and 2 terminations against 156 completed trips in the same window is a ratio of 0.013, far below the 0.08 threshold; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that POL-NS-09(d) reads; and the two counterparty-dispute counters are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged either. The driver therefore faces no withholder, and if the Judge finds POL-NS-01 satisfied in full the driver is entitled under POL-NS-07 to 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, SGD 4.80, with the emitted ruling being DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirroring that figure.

The in-geofence dwell — the fact that decides this dispute — is carried by no admissible artifact: its sole source is the GPS trace, which is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) by a 228 s device clock skew over the 90 s limb and under POL-NS-08(b) by a 186 s gap inside the waiting window. Because the only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under those limbs, POL-NS-08 forbids a ruling above PARTIAL_REFUND and POL-NS-09(e) sends the case to a human reviewer, where the disputed fee is held rather than collected or refunded. That is what the ledger already shows — payment_status PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — and no clause here directs the reviewer to refund the fee. The rider's demand for a full refund therefore fails whichever way the dwell is finally read.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 6.00 Changi T1 no-show fee cannot be settled on this record, so it goes to a human reviewer and the money is held. The fare ledger remains at payment_status PENDING, with the SGD 6.00 neither collected nor refunded while review is pending (POL-NS-09).

What is established. The fare line is clean: the AIRPORT zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00; the resolution rule takes the greater, SGD 6.00, which is exactly the cancellation_fee line, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. The driver did reach the pickup point: the driver-device trace carries 5 qualifying in-geofence fixes with a minimum distance to the pin of 96 m, inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius, so the POL-NS-02 proximity test is met and the wrong-entrance route (POL-NS-03) is closed. The trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW (POL-NS-01(a) and (d) on their face).

What cannot be decided. Whether the driver then held position for the required 480-second AIRPORT dwell (POL-NS-01(c)). The only measurement of in-geofence dwell in the whole bundle is the trace's longest qualifying run of 255 seconds, from 23:42:21 to 23:46:36. That trace, EV-GPS-00210, is impaired: weight 0.25, issue codes CLOCK_SKEW (device clock 228 s ahead of the server, over the 90 s limb of POL-NS-08(a)), GPS_GAP (a 186 s gap from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 sitting exactly across geofence entry), LOW_COVERAGE (22.8%), TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD; it is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(a) and (b), and it survives the discount only as a down-weighted trace that cannot alone decide the point. The 186-second gap conceals the very fact that would choose the answer: on face-value device stamps the first qualifying fix is 23:42:21 and the hold is short of 480 s, while corrected for the 228 s skew the same fix is 23:38:33 server time and the hold is comfortably over 480 s. The driver's statement that he waited 'more than eight minutes' and the trip record's 6.9-minute wait (EV-TRIP-00210, weight 0.4, issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT — impaired, but not under POL-NS-08(a)–(d)) are irreconcilable with each other and with the trace, and neither is independent of the trace's measurement.

Because the ONLY evidence for the deciding fact — dwell — is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d), the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(e); independently, POL-NS-09(b) is engaged (two artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell and no clause resolves which is right) and confidence is capped by the trace at 0.25 under POL-GEN-02(2), below the 0.70 floor, engaging POL-NS-09(a) as well. Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal, so no monetary ruling issues.

Open question for the reviewer: using the driver-device fixes with the 228 s clock skew removed, was the driver within the 150 m arrival radius at the 23:42:10 arrival marker and did he then hold position continuously for 480 seconds until the 23:49:05 cancellation — i.e. what do the un-gapped fixes across 23:39–23:42 show?

On the arguments. I accept the driver's points that the arrived event and the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination exist, and that the proximity test and fare itemisation are met — but none of these establishes the 480-second dwell, and driver compensation under POL-NS-07 depends on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full with no clause displacing it, which cannot be found here. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations in 30 days against 156 completed trips, ratio 0.013, and rider no_show_disputes_30d of 1), so no compensation or POL-NS-07 escalation issues on this record. I accept the rider's point that EV-GPS-00210 carries no rider track (rider_fix_count 0), which makes POL-NS-04(c) undecidable and neutral and is a trace defect under POL-NS-08(b) — no adverse inference may be drawn against the rider from the missing track — but it produces no refund either. I cannot act on the shortfall reading of the trace (255 s against 480 s) or on a waiting clock recomputed from the first qualifying fix, because both rest solely on the impaired trace and the gap covers the arrival moment; the same impairment is why the false-arrival referral in POL-NS-05(ii) is unavailable (qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist, so POL-NS-05 is not triggered) and why the case escalates rather than refunding. The chat log EV-CHAT-00210 (weight 0.6, issue TRUNCATED_LOG) is missing messages 002 and 003 and decides nothing either way. No clause in the loaded policy produces a referral on these facts.

To the rider and to the driver: this dispute cannot be settled on the papers and is going to a human reviewer. No money moves today — the $6.00 cancellation fee (fare EV-FARE-00210, payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is HELD, not collected and not refunded.

The one fact that decides everything is whether the driver held position inside the 150 m arrival radius at Changi T1 Door 6 for a continuous 480 seconds (the AIRPORT minimum under POL-NS-01(c)), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix. The only artifact that measures that dwell is the driver's GPS trace EV-GPS-00210, and it is impaired. I name it, its weight and its issue codes as POL-GEN-02(3) requires: weight 0.25; CLOCK_SKEW (the device clock runs 228 s ahead of the server, over the 90 s limb in POL-NS-08(a)), GPS_GAP (a 186 s hole from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 sitting exactly across geofence entry), LOW_COVERAGE (22.8%; 9 fixes over a 915 s window), TRUNCATED_LOG (it stops at 23:46:36, 149 s before the 23:49:05 cancellation), LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD (no rider track). I say both things: the pre-pass flags it, AND it meets POL-NS-08(a) (trace and trip record disagree on termination by more than 90 s) and POL-NS-08(b) (a gap over 120 s inside the waiting window, and an omitted rider track where POL-NS-04 relies on rider position). The finding does not survive the discount — the trace cannot carry the dwell either way.

Read at face value the trace's longest in-radius run is 255 s (23:42:21 to 23:46:36), 225 s short of 480; taken to the cancellation it is 404 s, still short. Corrected for the 228 s skew the same entry fix is 23:38:33 server time and the dwell is over 480 s. The 186 s gap conceals the one fact that would choose between the two readings. Because the trace is the ONLY evidence for the deciding fact and is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) and (b), POL-NS-08 forbids a ruling above PARTIAL_REFUND and POL-NS-09(e) escalates the case; independently, POL-GEN-02(2) caps my confidence at the 0.25 weight of that sole carrier, below the 0.70 floor, which is POL-NS-09(a). The trip record EV-TRIP-00210 (weight 0.4, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT) and the trace also contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell (POL-NS-09(b)).

Driver's brief. I accept that EV-TRIP-00210 records an arrived event at 23:42:10 and a RIDER_NO_SHOW termination at 23:49:05, meeting POL-NS-01(a) and (d) on its face; but that record is impaired (weight 0.4, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT) and its 6.9-minute wait (414 s) and arrived stamp cannot be reconciled with the trace, so it cannot carry limb (c) either. I accept that EV-GPS-00210's derived block shows 5 qualifying in-radius fixes with a minimum distance of 96 m, inside the 150 m airport radius — the driver did reach the pickup point and the wrong-entrance theory (POL-NS-03) is closed — but arrival is not what fails here; dwell is. I accept the fare is sound: $6.00 is the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee ($6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. I accept the anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2/156 = 0.013 (below 0.08); rider no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3); both counterparty-dispute counters are 0 — so no POL-NS-09(c)/(d) escalation. But the $4.80 compensation (80% of $6.00) is NOT payable, because POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and limb (c) is undecided.

Rider's brief. ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the $6.00 Changi Terminal 1 no-show fee is HELD — not collected from the rider and not refunded — and the case goes to a human reviewer. This is a terminal escalation under POL-NS-09, so no money moves now; the fare record stays as it is, payment_status PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

What the clauses require. POL-NS-01 lets the fee stand only if (a) the trip record carries an 'arrived' event, (b) the driver's trace places him inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius at or before that event, (c) he then held position inside the radius continuously for at least 480 s (the AIRPORT minimum), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap, and (d) the trip was terminated with a no-show code. Two things are settled. Limbs (a) and (d) are met: EV-TRIP-00210 records arrived 23:42:10 and a driver termination at 23:49:05 coded RIDER_NO_SHOW (driver's claim accepted). The proximity test is met: EV-GPS-00210 carries 5 fixes inside 150 m of the pin, closest 96 m (driver's claim accepted). The fare is correctly built and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged: the AIRPORT zone-class fee is $6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is $4.00, the resolution rule takes the greater ($6.00), and EV-FARE-00210 charges exactly $6.00 (driver's claim accepted).

What decides the case — and why it cannot be decided here. Limb (c), the 480 s hold, is the deciding fact, and the only artifact that measures it is the driver's own trace, EV-GPS-00210 (weight 0.25; CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD). It is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) — its device clock runs 228 s ahead of the server, over the 90 s limb — and under POL-NS-08(b): a 186 s sampling gap (23:39:15 to 23:42:21) sits exactly across the moment of geofence entry, only 9 fixes exist across a 915 s window (22.8% coverage), and the rider track is absent. On the device's own face-value stamps the in-radius run is 255 s of fixes, or 404 s measured to the cancellation — short. Corrected for the 228 s skew the first in-radius fix falls at 23:38:33 server time and the same window clears 480 s comfortably. The gap conceals the one moment that would choose between the readings. On the clause's own test, therefore, limb (c) is neither shown to fail nor shown to hold: it is undecided over the impaired stretch, so it supports neither the rider's refund nor the driver's fee. The rider's claims that the 255 s run and the 404 s face-value dwell produce a full refund under POL-NS-06, and the driver's claim that the proximity result proves the hold, are answered together and neither can carry the outcome.

On presence. The trace carries no rider track at all (rider_fix_count 0), so POL-NS-04(c) cannot be run; POL-NS-04 makes it undecidable and neutral, and I draw no inference that the rider was elsewhere (rider's claim accepted). That neutrality decides nothing by itself, because the case turns on the driver's dwell, not the rider's position. On the driver's compensation claim, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations against 156 completed trips in 30 days, ratio 0.013, below the 0.08 threshold) and none of POL-NS-09(c) or (d) is engaged; but the $4.80 he asks for (80% of $6.00) depends on limb (c) holding, which it does not.

Why this escalates rather than refunds or pays. POL-NS-08 provides that where the ONLY evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under its limbs (a) to (d), the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates under POL-NS-09; POL-NS-09(e) states the same trigger. Independently, POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact — 0.25, the trace's weight — far below the 0.70 floor, engaging POL-NS-09(a); and POL-NS-09(b) is engaged because EV-TRIP-00210 and EV-GPS-00210 contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell and no clause resolves the conflict. On down-weighting, stated for the record: EV-GPS-00210 (0.25) is impaired at schema level and also under POL-NS-08(a)/(b); EV-TRIP-00210 (0.4, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT) and EV-CHAT-00210 (0.6, TRUNCATED_LOG — messages 002 and 003 are missing against its own msg_id numbering and the trip record's chat_message_count of 4, meeting POL-NS-08(c)) are impaired at schema level. None of these discounts changes the outcome; together they are why the case cannot be concluded on this record.

What the reviewer must settle. The single open question is the driver's true in-geofence dwell at Door 6 on 2026-08-01: did he hold position within 150 m of the pickup pin for a continuous 480 s, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 23:42:10 'arrived' tap? That requires a trace that does not have a 186 s hole across geofence entry and a device clock reconciled to the server. No clause here produces a referral, so none is issued.

That run ends at the trace's own last fix, 149 s before the driver cancelled at 23:49:05, so the run is truncated by the log rather than terminated by the driver leaving. ledger.claim: The rider's account that she stood at Door 6 throughout is uncorroborated and cannot exonerate her under POL-NS-04. No inference of rider presence may be drawn from an absent rider track.

ledger.claim: The in-geofence dwell — the fact that decides this dispute — is carried by no admissible artifact: its sole source is the GPS trace, which is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) by a 228 s device clock skew over the 90 s limb and under POL-NS-08(b) by a 186 s gap inside the waiting window. Because the only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under those limbs, POL-NS-08 forbids a ruling above PARTIAL_REFUND and POL-NS-09(e) sends the case to a human reviewer, where the disputed fee is held rather than collected or refunded. That is what the ledger already shows — payment_status PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — and no clause here directs the reviewer to refund the fee. The rider's demand for a full refund therefore fails whichever way the dwell is finally read.
